articles.title: Six Sneaky Ways People Used Magic to Guard Their Homes
articles.summary: Long ago, people hid magic in their houses to keep bad luck away. They put witch bottles in walls, planted rosemary to trap witches, and carved stars on beams. Some even built seats for flying witches on their chimneys!

articles.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Game Delayed to 2027: More Time for Cursed Chaos
articles.summary: The new Jujutsu Kaisen game Rumble: Survivaton is now coming in 2027, not 2026. The studio behind Vampire Survivors is making it, and it's a battle royale with 20+ fighters. You can even change the rules mid-match!

articles.title: This 300-Year-Old Shipwreck Wood Became Two Beautiful Dresses
articles.summary: Scientists in Finland turned 300-year-old shipwreck wood into two elegant dresses. The wood came from a 1600s cargo ship found under a parking lot. The fabric feels like silk and is stronger than cotton—no dye or bleach needed!
